lines.zh: 我伏得很低，贴着地面滑过去。
lines.en: I keep low, sliding along the ground.
I move on four limbs as if crawling.

lines.zh: 这么长的身子，走路会折成几段。
lines.en: A body this long folds into segments when it moves.

lines.zh: 我闻着味道走，一直往前。
lines.en: I walk by scent, straight ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕过树，不想留下痕迹。
lines.en: I go around the trees to leave no trace.

lines.zh: 地上有一道拖痕，是我的。
lines.en: There's a drag mark on the ground. Mine.

lines.zh: 我每一步都试探，再落脚。
lines.en: Each step I test the ground before setting down.

lines.zh: 我朝气味更浓的方向去。
lines.en: I head where the smell is thicker.
The smells here are tangled.
I'm faster than I look.

lines.zh: 我把身体压进草里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I press into the grass, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我拖着长长的尾部，拐了个弯。
lines.en: I drag my long tail round a bend.
The wind turned; so did I.
I make no sound at all.

lines.zh: 离近了，我反而走得更慢。
lines.en: Closer in, I move more slowly.

lines.zh: 草尖动了一下，是我过去的。
lines.en: The grass tips stir as I pass.

lines.zh: 我伏在草里，只有眼睛在动。
lines.en: I lie in the grass; only my eyes move.
I listen, and I hear very far.
My body is slowly changing shape.

lines.zh: 捕食之前，总是最安静的。
lines.en: Before the hunt is always the quietest part.

lines.zh: 我数着风向，一天里改了很多次。
lines.en: I count the wind's turns. Many in a day.
The membrane on my back swells.
I don't need to breathe very often.

lines.zh: 海的味道，从这里也能闻到。
lines.en: Even here I can smell the sea.
I open my jaw slowly, then close it.
Waiting like this doesn't feel long.

lines.zh: 我看着一样东西，就很久不动。
lines.en: I fix on something and don't move for a long while.

lines.zh: 这片地方，还没有我的记号。
lines.en: This place has none of my marks yet.

lines.zh: 有东西在附近，我能感觉到。
lines.en: Something's nearby. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖得比身子长。
lines.en: My shadow trails longer than my body.

lines.zh: 你发现我了？那就没意思了。
lines.en: You've found me. Now it's no fun.
I won't move. You don't either.

lines.zh: 深海的颜色，水下游得最快。
lines.en: Deep-sea colors, and I swim fastest.
You're more alert than I expected.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我早就可以动了。
lines.en: At this distance I could have moved already.
You smell of an open wound.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只是为了看清你。
lines.en: I raise my head only to see you better.
You backed off. Noted.
Don't run. If you run, I chase.
Between us, who moves first?
A patch of my membrane is torn.
I retreat into the grass, fast.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我的伏击打散了。
lines.en: That broke up my ambush.
Blood on the grass. A heavy smell.
I flatten down and hide the wound.
The flesh is slowly closing.
The pain makes me want to bite more.
I pulled back, but I haven't left.
You're still standing there. Good.
This wound will harden into armor.
The smell changed. Fresh blood.
I poke my head out, but don't bite yet.

lines.zh: 这个味道，让我胃里发热。
lines.en: That smell sets something burning in me.
Don't push your hand any further.
I circle to the flank and edge closer.
I bite down but don't swallow yet.
That's only enough to taste.
I'm not picky. If I'm hungry, I eat.

lines.zh: 有东西掉在地上，我听见了。
lines.en: Something fell to the ground. I heard it.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就不追这一口。
lines.en: Step back and I'll let this bite go.

lines.zh: 深溟的尾鳍被你踩进沙里。
lines.en: You pressed my abyssal tail fin into the sand.

lines.zh: 深海的皮贴上来，又冷又黏。
lines.en: Deep-sea hide slides on you, cold and clingy.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的颚差点张开。
lines.en: That bump nearly opened my jaw.
Don't push me with your hand. It'll stick.
I draw back and flatten down again.

lines.zh: 我低伏着冲过，泥水四溅。
lines.en: I charge low, splashing mud.
I go round your feet without touching.

lines.zh: 你撞我，是想让我注意到你吗？
lines.en: Did you bump me to get my attention?
This close, holding back is hard.
One step aside. Just one.
My kind doesn't do this.

lines.zh: 靠过来，让我确认你的味道。
lines.en: Come closer. Let me confirm your scent.
Don't touch this membrane on me.

lines.zh: 我们并排伏着，谁也别动。
lines.en: We lie side by side. Neither moves.

lines.zh: 这个姿势，是为了伏击，不是亲近。
lines.en: This posture is for ambush, not affection.
You don't have the sea in you yet.
When I've grown, I'll come for you.

lines.zh: 你会慢慢变成我们中的一个。
lines.en: You'll slowly become one of us.
My senses are slow, my patience long.

lines.zh: 别走，我还想看你一会儿。
lines.en: Don't go. I want to watch you a while.
I take it in my jaw and toss my head.

lines.zh: 血味聚在鳃边，我兴奋了。
lines.en: Blood gathers at my gills; I grow excited.
I drag it into the grass to deal with.
I bury the catch under the soil.
Too small — hard to even hold.
I tear off half of this meat first.
You dropped it. Here.

lines.zh: 我从水里扑上来，先咬喉咙。
lines.en: I lunge from the water, going for the throat.

lines.zh: 味道留在嘴里，很久不散。
lines.en: The taste stays in my mouth a long time.
Keep it. Eat when hungry.

lines.zh: 有东西在喘气，就在那边。
lines.en: Something's breathing over there.
I flatten down and aim my head at you.

lines.zh: 这么远的距离，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell you from this far.

lines.zh: 你一迈腿，我就跟着动了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped, I moved.

lines.zh: 海嗣的脚步，已经上岸了.
lines.en: The Seaborn have come ashore.
The wind blows toward me. Good.
There's only one way through this grass.
I don't shout. I don't warn.
You standing there is perfect.
From here on, slowly.
I follow without a sound.
You looked back; I flattened down.
You speed up; I slow down.
At this range, I wait a while.
Your direction is very predictable.
I circle ahead to wait for you.

lines.zh: 我伏在水下，等你再近一点。
lines.en: I lie underwater, waiting for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 草一直在动，你别看错了。
lines.en: The grass keeps moving. Don't misread it.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚边了。
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 再走十步，就进我的范围了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you're in my reach.

lines.zh: 我从草里扑出来，咬你的腿。
lines.en: I burst from the grass and bite your leg.
My jaw opens wider than your face.

lines.zh: 一咬就拖，把你往草里带。
lines.en: I bite and drag you toward the grass.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里钩，拔不出来。
lines.en: My teeth hook inward. They won't pull free.
That one wasn't fast.

lines.zh: 你踢我，我就换个地方咬。
lines.en: Kick me and I'll bite somewhere else.
I hold you down with my weight.

lines.zh: 咬合的时候，会听见声音。
lines.en: You'll hear the bite close.
I never bite twice.
This bite is for the sea.
I raise my head out of the grass.
The membrane on me is still wet.
I flatten down and survey the area.
This ground has no marks on it.
My body is longer than it looks.

lines.zh: 我从水里爬上岸，一路滴水。
lines.en: I crawl out of the water, dripping.
My smell arrives first. I follow.
The grass parts for me.
I stretch out slowly, joints crackling.

lines.zh: 这里很快就会有我的痕。
lines.en: My marks will be here soon.

lines.zh: 火燎过来，我的膜缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire swept in; my membrane shriveled.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，摔得翻了身。
lines.en: I dropped from above and landed on my back.
In water I'm actually more agile.

lines.zh: 震得我整个身子散开又合上。
lines.en: The blast scattered my body and it closed again.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我背上的膜。
lines.en: Something pierced the membrane on my back.

lines.zh: 那光让我的关节都僵了。
lines.en: That light stiffened every joint.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的身子开始缩。
lines.en: Starving this long, my body is shrinking.

lines.zh: 雷顺着草过来，我弹了起来。
lines.en: Lightning came through the grass and I convulsed.
No grass here. Nowhere to hide.
